decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch that is still listed, this product likely has at least acceptable early traction, and in an expanding medium-sized innovative firm with some slack management would usually keep such a close-to-core offering unless 2025 results clearly fall short of aspiration levels.

This energy management system fits the firm's strategic move toward digital, system-wide efficiency and environmental performance, so with growth, R&D capability, and organizational slack the firm is likely to view it as meeting or worth continuing to test against aspirations.

Because it had its own dedicated web page in 2024 and closely supports the firm's established water-control business, management is likely to see enough commitment and expected fit to retain it unless performance soon proves clearly below aspiration.
